properties.description: Normalized custom injection signal followed strictly later within 10 minutes by a successful tool invocation or external submission in the same registered agent session.
properties.displayName: AI Agent | Optional: injection signal followed by a successful agent action
properties.query:
let Agents = _GetWatchlist('AIAgentInventory')
    | where tolower(tostring(Enabled)) == 'true'
    | project AgentId = tolower(tostring(AgentId))
    | where isnotempty(AgentId) | distinct AgentId;
let Events = AIAgentEvent_CL
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h) and SchemaVersion == '1.0'
    | extend AgentId = tolower(AgentId)
    | where isnotempty(AgentId) and isnotempty(SessionId) and isnotempty(EventId)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AgentId, EventId
    | join kind=inner Agents on AgentId;
let Signals = Events | where EventType == 'InjectionSignal'
    | project AgentId, SessionId, SignalAt = TimeGenerated, SignalId = EventId;
let Actions = Events | where EventType in ('ToolInvocation', 'ExternalSubmission') and Outcome == 'Succeeded'
    | project AgentId, SessionId, ActionAt = TimeGenerated, ActionId = EventId, ActorUPN = tolower(ActorUPN), ToolName, EventType;
Signals
| join kind=inner Actions on AgentId, SessionId
| where ActionAt > SignalAt and ActionAt <= SignalAt + 10m and ActionId != SignalId
| summarize arg_max(SignalAt, *) by AgentId, SessionId, ActionId
| project TimeGenerated = ActionAt, AgentId, ActorUPN, SessionId,
          Evidence = tostring(bag_pack('signalEventId', SignalId, 'signalAt', SignalAt, 'actionEventId', ActionId, 'actionType', EventType, 'toolName', ToolName, 'assessment', 'Ordered session association; malicious influence not proven')),
          CorrelationQuality = 'heuristic', AccountCustomEntity = ActorUPN
